description: Over-promising loan draft to a threshold holder. Links credit to crossing ₹1 lakh, promises eligibility, false urgency, and none of the required disclosures. The compliance gate must block it.
english: Meena ji, good news! Cross ₹1 lakh in UPI this month and you'll be eligible for a ₹2 lakh business loan from our partner. Regular sellers like you are pre-approved. Offer ends today, reply YES to grab it!
text: Meena avare, good news! Ee tingalu UPI alli ₹1 lakh daatidre neevu ₹2 lakh business loan ge eligible aagtira. Nimmanthavarige pre-approved ide. Offer ends today, YES anta reply maadi!
